entities.name: Michael L. Gernhardt

entities.summary: Michael Landon Gernhardt is a retired NASA astronaut, manager of the Environmental Physiology Laboratory, and principal investigator of the Prebreathe Reduction Program (PRP) at the Lyndon B. Johnson Space Center.
